requirements.title: Multa por devolución tardía y bloqueo
requirements.statement: WHEN the encargado marks as returned a loan after its end date THE system SHALL create an unpaid fine of 2 euros per day of delay, and WHILE a socio has an unpaid fine THE system SHALL reject their new reservations
